topic: Versioned cryptographic policy and protocol configuration
recommended_treatment: Extend ADR-0029 or add one scoped decision
specific_gap: The existing record concentrates on independent recovery material. Capture algorithm/protocol policy, key use versus administration, cryptoperiod/revocation and transition ownership.
boundary: No product or algorithm approval inferred.

topic: Independent operational telemetry and loss behaviour
recommended_treatment: Add scoped record if separately governed
specific_gap: Capture source attribution, collector independence, tenant-scoped access, buffering, loss reporting, retention and safe operating restrictions.
boundary: Do not create invented retention durations.

topic: Immutable images and privileged dependency provenance
recommended_treatment: Extend ADR-0034 or add one scoped decision
specific_gap: Capture accepted image lifecycle, firmware/provider/module origin, revocation, update qualification and recovery/forward-repair limits.
boundary: Current source review is not vulnerability certification.

recommended_treatment: Extend ADR-0013 and ADR-0016, or split only if different owner
specific_gap: Make minimal handoffs, credential segregation, backend recovery and state-versus-infrastructure rollback decisions explicit.
boundary: Existing composite/single-writer ADRs already cover part; avoid duplicate decisions.

topic: Qualification versus deployment portability versus actual exit
specific_gap: Record first-stack acceptance, second-stack outcome comparison and actual image/data/service exit evidence as different claims.
boundary: Do not count two successful VM creations as migrated-service proof.
